items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
Unit out of service.
Crane or hoist
Chain block and wire rope
Nylon sling ( two or three lines )
Eye bolt M24 ( three pieces each)
Wooden block for laying under the tube nest
Wrench, screw driver ... etc.
Measure inlet and outlet temperature of oil and record it
Measure inlet and outlet temperature of cooling water and record it

Stop operation of heat exchanger ( first cut off fluid of shell flow 
 gradually "oil" and then cooling water).
Drain both fluid left in heat exchanger through drain valves.
Dismantle the water chamber at both ends
Remove the outer O ring fit to the O ring holder
Remove the O ring holder and also the inner O ring

Use the female threaded holes provided on the tube sheet, screw in the 
 push up bolts to separate the tube plate from the shell by about 50 mm
Tie the nylon sling around the outer periphery of the fixed tube sheet

Left up the tube sheet to the level where the center line of the shell matches 
 with the center of tube nest

Screw in the eye bolts into the threaded holes in place of push up bolts and 
 pull laterally with a chain block and extract the tube nest

When extract the length of about 70% of the overall length, tie another nylon 
 sling around the baffle plate and extract the tube nest to its full length

Upon completion of extraction lay the tube nest on a wooden blocks to protect 
 the cooling tubes and baffle plates
Clean the internal surface of the shell
Clean the external surface of the tube with air or light oil
Clean sludge or deposit inside the tube with brushes or tube cleaner
Check tube surface anti scratch and damage
Replace O rings

Sling the tube nest, lift it gradually, insert it in the shell, be sure that 
 the center line of the tube nest matches with the center line of the shell
Be careful to complete the insertion of the tube nest in the shell
Mount the O ring older and the inner O ring
Mount the outer O ring
Assemble the water chamber of both ends
Close drain valves
Flow cooling water and confirm that no problem in the tube side pass
Flow oil gradually in the shell side
After the by pass filled with fluid air vent on each side are closed
Check oil temperature ( in and out)
Check cooling water temperature ( in and out )
